findings.issue: The lamed plus 3mp suffix is the beneficiary and the thing made is the construct gods-of gold. «hicieron a ellos dioses» makes ellos the object turned into gods.
findings.spanishSpan: hicieron a ellos dioses de oro

findings.issue: The particle is an entreaty (ah / please). «¡Ay!» adds a cry of grief.

notes: Moisés, Jehová, the cognate pecado, and the 3ms-to-3mp shift match the tokens.
